```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)

```

```{r}
sleepFinal <- read_xlsx("FINAL.xlsx",sheet="Minuet")
sleepFinal <- cbind(sleepFinal,Abstinence=c("Before","Before","Before","Before","Before","Before","Before",
                                            "After","After","After","After","After","After","After",
                                            "After","After","After","After","After","After","After"))
```

## BOX PLOT MEAN TIME BEFOR AND AFTER ABSTINENCE PERIOD
```{r}
  sleepFinal$Abstinence <- factor(sleepFinal$Abstinence, levels = c("Before", "After"))
powerPoint <- ggplot(data = sleepFinal, aes(x = Abstinence, y = sleep, fill = Abstinence, color = Abstinence))+
              geom_boxplot( color = "black")+
              theme(axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold",size = 20))+
              theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold",size = 20))+
              theme_bw()+
              labs(x="Period",y="Sleep Time")
powerPoint
ggsave("box.png",powerPoint)
```

## LINE GRAPH TO SHOW SLEEP DURATION THROUGH THE TWO PERIODS
```{r}
sleepFinal$Day <- as.Date(sleepFinal$Day)
sleepFinal$Abstinence <- factor(sleepFinal$Abstinence, levels = c("Before", "After"))
powerPointLine <- ggplot(data = sleepFinal, aes(x = as.Date(Day), y =sleep,colour = Abstinence)) +
                      geom_line(aes(group = 1), linewidth = 1) +
                      geom_point(color="blue",size = 2)+
                      scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 day", date_labels = "%m/%d") +
                      labs(x = "Day", y = "Sleep Duration (hr)") +
                      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1,face = "bold"))+
                      theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"))
powerPointLine
ggsave("line.png",powerPointLine)
```

## BAR GRAPH TO SHOW WITHDRAWAL SYSMPTOM THROUGH THE TWO PERIODS 
```{r}
powerPointBar <-ggplot(data=sleepFinal,aes(x=Day,y=Withdrawal))+
                geom_col(fill="maroon")+
                scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%m/%d")+
                theme_bw()+
                theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5,
                                                    hjust = 1,colour = "Navy",face = "bold"))
powerPointBar
ggsave("bar.png",powerPointBar)
          
```
